S.FORM: alang Ryohen ga niya mki sku Girang Keng atu Nango go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 178 buwan, 569 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 94% kyan ku 534 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 6% kyan ku 35 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Tayan 90%, Amis 1%, Truku 1%, Bunun 1%. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Ryohen hya' ga K'babaw. tay mkyahu' na Ryohen hya' ga Hagaparis. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy maki 1 pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy. pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ rjoħen ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku ɣiraŋ keŋ atu naŋo ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa tajan ** ami[s|ɕ] * truku * βunun * rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na rjoħen ħjaʔ ɣa kʔβaβaw taj mkjaħuʔ na rjoħen ħjaʔ ɣa ħaɣapari[s|ɕ] reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj maki * pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
